name: GalaxyBoard - ZoomedIn
description: The same worked board after the camera has been zoomed in — the state every other GalaxyBoard scenario is missing, because all four of them sit at the opening framed-all zoom. It is the state this feature is about: the board scales and the frame around it does not, which is the whole claim of moving wheel and pinch onto native listeners that call preventDefault instead of a React onWheel prop the browser was free to zoom the page on. Reached by the zoom control rather than a trackpad pinch, because a capture browser cannot emit one; what the frame proves is the camera's end of the gesture.
